answer: For a poll on a raven at the zenith of a mural, the server verifies a hospital-signed blood donation receipt bound to each ballot. It accepts each valid receipt once and rejects invalid or reused receipts. Extra votes require more donations or receipts from donors. Donation eligibility and privacy limit access; donors can collude, so this is not proof of one person per vote. The idea has a kernel of deterrence, not a guarantee.
